summary: Second dispatch (session sess_1784065982_0f4e12) completed Phases 8-11 of the 11-phase plan. Phases 1-7 were already landed and independently verified by the prior dispatch. Phase 8 built probes/cs5-pair-primeness.lean (sorry-free): the pair poset with designated-formula exclusion, a clean seed-membership proof (fixing Pacheco's asserted-seed defect), a clean chain-upper-bound step (fixing his absent-chain-step defect), and the general order fact that pair-maximality projects to per-component maximality. It also surfaced a genuine, previously-unanticipated finding: that component-maximality does not by itself let the library's single-formula prime_maximal_is_prime apply, because the natural cross-condition predicate (boxInv X subset Y, Y fixed) is not stable under deductive closure -- Zorn-closing an insertion can derive new box-formulas not pinned to Y. A repair (a combined derivation system over Atom-sum-Atom baking the cross-conditions in as axioms rather than an external invariant) was designed and documented but not built, given the combined Phase 9/10 time budget. Phases 9-10 are therefore marked BLOCKED per the escalation protocol (full writeup in the plan file: what failed, what was tried, why, what is needed). Per the dispatch's binding rule 5 (fallback is success, not failure), this triggered Phase 11 Branch B: the three-world cs5FC'' countermodel (previously only a probe) was landed into CS5.lean itself (CS5BoxGapWorld plus five theorems), proving the box-backward gap (cs5_symmetric_tail_box_gap, landed in the prior dispatch) is non-vacuous -- its hypotheses are jointly satisfiable in a genuine model, not an artifact of a weak proof attempt. CS5.lean's module docstring was revised to its final, honest status: soundness over cs5FC'' and the canonical frame conditions are fully established (both axiom-free at the two hard-gated theorems); the diamond cases of a prospective truth lemma are free; completeness is open specifically at the box-backward pair construction -- not a library-level 'CS5 completeness is blocked' verdict, and not for the reason task 508 originally (and already-refuted) claimed. Full CI gate green: project-wide lake build (3233/3242 jobs, remaining warnings all pre-existing and unrelated), checkInitImports, lint-style, lake lint (one pre-existing unrelated error elsewhere, zero in CS5.lean), lake shake, mk_all (no update needed), lake test (exit 0). Zero sorries, zero new axioms, zero vacuous definitions introduced.

blockers.description: Phases 9-10 (the box-backward pair construction proper) are BLOCKED. The primeness step for the pair's components cannot be discharged by projecting pair-maximality onto the library's single-formula prime_maximal_is_prime/set_maximal_is_prime, because the natural cross-condition predicate Cons_Y(X) := boxInv X subset Y (Y held fixed) is not stable under the deductive-closure operator those lemmas require. A repair via a combined derivation system over Atom-sum-Atom (tagging each component's formulas, adding the cross-conditions as axioms rather than an external invariant) is designed and documented in probes/cs5-pair-primeness.lean's module docstring, but needs new Proposition.map/DerivationTree functoriality infrastructure estimated at several hundred lines -- a follow-up task, not attempted in this dispatch given the combined Phase 9/10 time bound. decisions_made: Phase 8: the pair poset uses designated-formula exclusion (box A not in X, A not in Y), never a bot-exclusion invariant -- LANDED, matches the revised design.

Phase 8: the seed pair (H, cl(boxInv H)) needs no Pacheco-style Upsilon/Phi MP-closure preprocessing -- boxInv H subset H (axiom T) plus H already deductively closed gives cl(boxInv H) subset H directly, and A not in cl(boxInv H) follows directly from box A not in H via box_mem_of_boxed_context -- LANDED (cs5_pair_seed_mem).

Phase 8: the chain-upper-bound step needs no directed-union-specific reasoning -- boxInv and designated-formula membership are both pointwise, so they commute with arbitrary unions -- LANDED (cs5_pair_chain_union_mem).

Phase 8 FINDING (not anticipated by the plan): the general order fact (pair-maximal implies component-maximal-with-other-fixed) is free, but does NOT by itself let prime_maximal_is_prime apply, because the natural Cons predicate (boxInv X subset Y) is not closure-stable. Documented in full with a worked repair sketch (combined derivation system over Atom-sum-Atom) rather than built, given time bounds.
Phases 9-10: BLOCKED per escalation protocol rather than attempted with a broken/incomplete construction. No sorry, no bot-exclusion fallback, no negation-completeness shortcut used anywhere.

Phase 11: Branch B taken. The countermodel (probes/cs5-boxgap-countermodel.lean) was landed into CS5.lean verbatim in mathematical content, renamed to library-appropriate identifiers (W3 -> CS5BoxGapWorld, w3* -> cs5BoxGap*) and given docstrings/nolint attributes for CSLib lint compliance.
Phase 11: CS5.lean's module docstring was rewritten to state final honest status without claiming a library-level BLOCKED verdict, per the plan's explicit Branch B instruction.

No collapse-inheritance byproduct: the pair poset never carries a bot-exclusion invariant, so nothing forces W-bot = empty or re-proves CS5-derivability iff IS5-derivability; the collapse-check obligation (binding rule 4) was not triggered.
dead_ends: Reusing Metalogic.prime_maximal_is_prime/set_maximal_is_prime directly via a Cons predicate encoding the cross-condition (boxInv X subset Y, Y fixed): fails because Cons is not stable under the deductive-closure operator those lemmas require for their internal insert-and-close argument. This is DISTINCT from, and a refinement of, the earlier-ruled-out bot-exclusion and sequential-Lindenbaum dead ends -- it is a defect in the specific single-formula-exclusion machinery's applicability to a PAIR's cross-condition, not in the designated-formula-exclusion swap itself (which remains correct and necessary).

A Sum-type (Atom ⊕ Atom) encoding using a fresh HasImp/HasOr instance on the sum type directly: does not work, since Sum F F is not closed under forming mixed implications/disjunctions between the two summands -- the repair instead needs a doubled ATOM space (Proposition (Atom ⊕ Atom)), not a doubled FORMULA space.

Mixing the designated exclusion formula A into the same box-shaped exclusion set E := {box B | B not in H'} used for the boxInv-cross-condition machinery (Phase 6/7's technique): fails, because a disjunct-in-H' witness of shape A (as opposed to box B) is not itself a contradiction the way a box B witness is -- the two obligations (exclude A from T, exclude box B's not-in-H' from H') are not uniformly dischargeable by the same n-ary bigOr apparatus.
